title: [Kernel] Bump FlashKDA to keep the recurrent state in fp32 (#58846)
body:
## Purpose

Bumps the FlashKDA pin from `b59532f` to `17a037d`, the merge of vllm-project/FlashKDA#13 on its `dev` branch.

Before this change, FlashKDA's K2 kernel stored the KDA recurrent state in bf16 and rounded it after every 16-token tile. ## Purpose

With async scheduling, `FLASHINFER_MLA_SPARSE_SM90` did a blocking D2H copy on every metadata build.
